newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$6.00/cubic metre or C$0.95/barrel, effective immediately.

The new prices were listed as follows: Edmonton light sweet C$204.00/cubic metre, or C$32.43/barrel Cromer light sour C$200.00/cubic metre, or C$31.80/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$180.00/cubic metre, or C$28.62/barrel Midale at Cromer C$190.00/cubic metre, or C$30.21/barrel -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
